record.paper_title: A survey of equivariant map algebras with open problems
record.original_question: Let a be a finite-dimensional associative algebra over an algebraically closed field, let X be an affine scheme with coordinate algebra A, let Γ act on X and a by automorphisms, and set M = M(X,a)^Γ, the Γ-fixed subalgebra of a ⊗ A. Go beyond the classification of irreducible finite-dimensional M-modules by describing all indecomposable finite-dimensional M-modules and the block decomposition of the corresponding finite-dimensional module category.

evidence.quote: The action of Γ on X induces an action on the coordinate ring A of X. Then M = (a ⊗ A)Γ , the fixed points of the diagonal action of Γ on a ⊗ A.

4.2.3. Indecomposable modules. The classification of the irreducible objects in the category of finite-dimensional modules of M for an associative a in Theorem 2.1 is only a first step towards a complete understanding of the category. Ideally, one would like to describe all of the indecomposable finite-dimensional modules and understand the block decomposition of this category.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field, let $\mathfrak{a}$ be a finite-dimensional associative $k$-algebra, and let $X$ be an affine scheme over $k$ with coordinate algebra $A = \mathcal{O}(X)$. Let $\Gamma$ be a group acting by $k$-algebra automorphisms on both $\mathfrak{a}$ and $A$ (equivalently, on $X$), and consider the diagonal $\Gamma$-action on $\mathfrak{a} \otimes_k A$. Define the equivariant map algebra
$$M = M(X, \mathfrak{a})^\Gamma = (\mathfrak{a} \otimes_k A)^\Gamma,$$
the $\Gamma$-fixed subalgebra of $\mathfrak{a} \otimes_k A$.

Beyond the known classification of the irreducible finite-dimensional $M$-modules, give an explicit description of:
(a) all indecomposable finite-dimensional $M$-modules (up to isomorphism), and
(b) the block decomposition of the category of finite-dimensional $M$-modules.
artifact.status_search_result: For the Lie algebra version of equivariant map algebras, the block decomposition of the finite-dimensional representation category has been described explicitly via spectral characters (Neher–Savage, Transformation Groups 2015), and analogous results exist for equivariant map superalgebras. However, a complete classification of all indecomposable finite-dimensional modules in the associative-algebra setting M = (a ⊗ A)^Γ does not appear to be available; only partial results (irreducibles, extensions, and certain block decompositions) are known. The problem as stated thus appears partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Extensions and Block Decompositions for Finite-Dimensional Representations of Equivariant Map Algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Describes blocks of the category of finite-dimensional representations of equivariant map algebras explicitly in terms of spectral characters.
status_evidence.claim: The block decomposition part of the problem is addressed for the Lie case.

status_evidence.title: Irreducible modules for equivariant map superalgebras and their extensions
status_evidence.snippet: Classifies irreducible finite-dimensional modules and computes extensions for equivariant map superalgebras.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress beyond irreducibles is available in related settings.

status_evidence.title: A survey of equivariant map algebras with open problems
status_evidence.snippet: States that classification of indecomposables and full block decomposition for the associative case is desired but not known.
status_evidence.claim: The full problem is posed as open in the survey.
